title: Rawafid
description: A multilingual CMS platform for a community, articles, and events, built during a three-month freelance engagement ending October 1, 2026.
imageAlt: Rawafid community platform homepage with flowing connector artwork
architecture: A PHP-based content platform with separate public pages and an admin area. The site organizes community programs, projects, articles, and events; CSS and JavaScript support the responsive, multilingual experience.
highlights: Publish and organize community articles and knowledge content.
Present programs, projects, and events in one community hub.
Manage site content and users through the admin area.
Support multilingual site content and dynamic article categories.

title: Tech Xpress
description: An electronics e-commerce platform focused on a smooth shopping experience, responsive access, and dependable order workflows.
architecture: A full-stack ASP.NET Core MVC application organized into web, data-access, and shared utility projects. Entity Framework supports persistence; repository and unit-of-work patterns structure data access. ASP.NET Identity handles authentication, while Stripe powers checkout.
highlights: Browse electronics through category navigation and product search.
Register, sign in, manage a shopping cart, and place orders.
Complete checkout using Stripe payment integration.
Admin tools manage products and categories.
imageAlt: Tech Xpress storefront with featured electronics and product promotion

title: E-Learning Platform with AI Chatbot
description: A graduation project that helps students explore technology resources, learning paths, books, and instructor content with support from an AI chatbot.
architecture: An ASP.NET Core MVC application using ASP.NET Identity, SQL Server, and Razor views. The AI chatbot adds a conversational way for learners to get help while exploring the platform.
highlights: Explore online learning content, courses, and instructor resources.
Browse learning paths and a book library alongside course content.
Use an AI chatbot for conversational learning assistance.
Completed as a team graduation project and awarded an Excellent project grade.
imageAlt: E-learning platform homepage for online learning and course discovery

title: El Wakeel Law Firm Website
description: A production digital platform for El Wakeel Law Firm (Premier Legal Practice in Egypt & GCC), presenting 20+ years of legal advocacy, 1,500+ closed cases, practice areas, partner credentials, and instant WhatsApp consultation booking.
architecture: A responsive front-end corporate web application built with HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, and JavaScript, with jQuery and interactive carousel sections. Formspree handles lead generation, and direct WhatsApp routing powers client inquiries.
highlights: High-converting consultation landing experience with direct WhatsApp integration and appointment booking.
Showcase 12+ practice domains: commercial advisory, corporate law, dispute resolution, and high-stakes advocacy.
Features 20+ years of experience, 1,500+ closed cases, 98% satisfaction, partner profiles, and client reviews.
Responsive gold-accented corporate aesthetic built for high performance and lead capture across all devices.
imageAlt: El Wakeel Law Firm live portal showing Premier Legal Practice in Egypt and GCC

title: DevERP — Developer ERP & Cash Flow Suite
description: An offline-first Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) and multi-currency cash flow terminal built for freelance software engineers and consultants, featuring real-time financial forecasting, milestone CRM, and client-side PDF invoicing.
architecture: An offline-first desktop and web ERP engineered with React 19, TypeScript, and Vite, packaged for Windows with Electron and electron-builder. Employs a zero-cloud local persistence engine, a custom Foreign Exchange conversion pipeline, client-side PDF invoice generation via jsPDF, and hardware-accelerated charting with Tailwind CSS v4 and Motion.
highlights: Multi-currency invoicing and cash flow ledger supporting EGP (E£), USD ($), and EUR (€) with locked FX conversion rates.
Milestone-based deliverables CRM tracking status lifecycles from Pending through Completed to Billed.
Built-in printable PDF invoice generator powered by jsPDF embedding bank wire remittance coordinates (IBAN/SWIFT).
Financial forecasting dashboard with 30-day runway projection, burn-rate monitoring, and monthly cash flow charts.
100% offline privacy with zero external database dependencies, local JSON backup export, and instant database restore.
Dual-target distribution running as both a fast responsive web application and a native Windows desktop app via Electron.
imageAlt: DevERP Executive Terminal dashboard showing multi-currency cash flow momentum, forecast, burn rate, and receivables
